name: claude-simple-stats-bar
description: Editor stats and live Claude Code session usage (model, tokens, cost, context %, multi-session and history) in the VS Code status bar.

commands.title: Claude Simple Stats Bar: Open Session Panel
Claude Simple Stats Bar: Switch Primary Session

claudeSimpleStatsBar.pollIntervalMs.description: Fallback poll interval (ms), alongside the file watcher.

claudeSimpleStatsBar.contextWindowTokens.description: Override the model's context window in tokens, for the context-usage % and compaction detection. Leave at 0 to auto-detect from the model (1,000,000 for Sonnet/Opus/Fable, 200,000 for Haiku 4.5).

claudeSimpleStatsBar.showContextBar.description: Show the 6-segment fill bar next to the context-usage tag. Off keeps just the icon, tag, and percentage.

claudeSimpleStatsBar.pricing.description: USD per 1M tokens, keyed by model id, e.g. { "claude-sonnet-5": { "inputPerMillion": 3, "outputPerMillion": 15, "cacheWritePerMillion": 3.75, "cacheReadPerMillion": 0.3 } }. Overrides built-in defaults for Sonnet/Opus/Haiku/Fable. Unlisted models with no entry show cost as n/a.
